title: Shipment documents on file
description: Every document in required_documents is marked as on file for the shipment, once grace_days have passed since entry.
remediation: Obtain the missing document from the supplier or forwarder and attach it to the entry file.

title: Code of conduct acknowledged
description: The supplier has a code-of-conduct acknowledgment date, once grace_days have passed since onboarding.
remediation: Send the code of conduct to the supplier and record the date of the signed acknowledgment.

title: Material declaration on file
description: The product has a material declaration date.
remediation: Request a material declaration for the product from the supplier and record its date.

title: Certificate expired
description: The certificate's expiry date plus grace_days is before the check date.
remediation: Request the renewed certificate from the supplier and update the expiry date.

title: Certificate expiring soon
description: The certificate has not expired and expires within days_ahead days.
remediation: Ask the supplier for the renewal plan before the certificate lapses.

title: Insurance expired
description: The supplier's insurance expiry date plus grace_days is before the check date, or no date is recorded.
remediation: Request a current certificate of insurance and update the expiry date.

title: Supplier audit overdue
description: The supplier's last audit is older than max_age_months, or no audit date is recorded.
remediation: Schedule an audit and record its date.

title: Material declaration out of date
description: The product's material declaration is older than max_age_months.
remediation: Request an updated material declaration from the supplier.

title: Tariff code format
description: The tariff code fully matches the regular expression in pattern. The default expects digits written as 0000.00.0000.
remediation: Correct the tariff code on the entry; confirm the classification with your customs broker.

title: Origin differs from supplier's countries
description: The shipment's country of origin is the supplier's country or one of the supplier's other_origins.
remediation: Confirm the origin with the supplier. Correct the entry, or add the country to the supplier's other_origins if it is legitimate.

title: Declared unit value out of line
description: The declared value per unit is not an outlier among shipments with the same tariff code (robust score within threshold).
remediation: Compare the declared value and quantity with the commercial invoice; correct a keying or unit error, or note why the value is right.

title: Description does not fit tariff chapter
description: A text classifier trained on these records does not find the declared chapter unlikely for the goods description.
remediation: Have the classification reviewed by your customs broker; correct the code or the description.

title: Filed after deadline
description: The entry was filed by the end of the day deadline_days days after the entry date.
remediation: File the entry if it is still open, and record the reason for the delay.

title: Records purged before retention period
description: The shipment's records were not purged within retention_years years of the entry date.
remediation: Restore the records from backup or obtain copies from the broker or supplier.

title: Name resembles a screening-list entry
description: The supplier's name does not score at or above threshold against any entry on the loaded screening list.
remediation: Have a person review the potential match against identifying details (address, registration, ownership) and record the outcome. The score alone decides nothing.
